snippet.title: One Fenix Down - 2026 Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. ONE FENIX DOWN combines 16-bit SNES-style graphics and expressive hand-drawn portraits with an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption. 

Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2822740

Key Features:

40+ Hours of Adventure: Travel across continents, kingdoms, and realms beyond in a far-reaching, character-driven journey.

Traditional Turn‑Based Combat: A tried‑and‑true system enhanced with modern mechanics and three difficulty settings designed to welcome genre newcomers and challenge veterans.

A Large, Evolving Cast: Meet a large cast of characters, each with their own motives, objectives, and ambitions.

14+ Playable Party Members: A rotating cast of characters help to keep the story and party composition fresh, while encouraging new tactics and strategies.

Powerful Abilities & Excedo Skills: Wield elemental magic, martial arts, traps, monster abilities, and character-specific Excedo skills unleashed when each character’s Excedo meter fills.

Hundreds of Items & Equipment: Hundreds of unique items and equipment waiting to be discovered, many requiring an adventurous spirit to obtain.

Nostalgic SNES-Era Audio: A retro-inspired soundtrack featuring guest vocalist Emi Evans, unlocked as a Kickstarter stretch goal.


Trailer Details:
Music by Thomas J. Peters (Lead Composer)

Game in development, final product subject to change
